response.overview: A boy (bathed in red light) and a girl (bathed in blue light) exchange music with each other, then listen to each other’s music. As the music plays, blue squiggles begin to travel from the boy’s headphones to his heart, while red squiggles do the same for the girl. The melody transports them into a state of euphoria, where their blue and red souls dance through the ether as squiggles, then turn purple at the moment of their kiss.
response.title: Színergia
